criteria.name: ML Model Development
criteria.guidance: Implement suitable regression models such as Decision Tree, Random Forest and boosting with consistent preprocessing.

criteria.name: Hyperparameter Tuning & Validation
criteria.guidance: Tune selected parameters on training data using appropriate cross-validation; keep the test set untouched.

criteria.name: Model Comparison & Performance Evaluation
criteria.guidance: Compare models using the same split and MAE/RMSE/R²; interpret practical differences and errors.

criteria.name: Risk Factor / Feature Importance Analysis
criteria.guidance: Interpret feature importance or model explanations cautiously; distinguish association from causation.

criteria.name: Clustering & Customer Segmentation
criteria.guidance: Aggregate customer-level purchase behaviour, scale appropriate features, evaluate clusters and explain segments with evidence.
